title: 第2165章 根正苗红第2164章 慌什么
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：领主：从开拓骑士开始第一卷：默认第2165章根正苗红（..la）“站住。”
庄园入口处，一名军官抬手将寒冰军团战士拦了下来。
白银高阶战士抬手止住了前进的部队，大跨步来到庄园入口处，将抓捕命令文件亮了出来。
军官看着上面的内容，瞳孔微缩。
上面的印章，他分辨不出真假，但是就凭借上面的内容，他感觉也没有人敢伪造这份命令文件。
“现在你们可以让开了。”白银高阶战士将命令文件折叠好塞入盔甲内侧，抬头看着面前的军官，开口说道。
“是。”
军官咬了咬牙，挥手示意部下退下，将道路让了出来。
白银高阶战士见状，挥手示意部下进入庄园。
入口处，蓝发青年看着进入庄园的军队，瞬间愣在了原地。
“伯纳德，我跟你说……”
费恩抬头看着向他们而来的银甲军队，尤其是盔甲上那熟悉的印记，让他瞬间失声。
自领主大人入住奥克拉城王宫后，祈星军团与寒冰军团便担任起了王宫卫军和奥克拉城护军的职责。
现在成建制的寒冰军团战士出现在这里，肯定不是为了传达命令而来。
白银高阶战士看了一眼伯纳德后，转头看向站在一旁的费恩，沉声道：“你是费恩？”
“我是。”费恩收起了心中的杂念，十分坦然的回答道。
“是你就好。”白银高阶战士上下打量了费恩一番后，当即命令道，“将他抓起来。”
两名白银低阶战士走上前，用绳索将费恩捆了起来。
铁锁落下，藏于铁链内的魔法阵被激活，只是一瞬间，费恩体内的斗气完全被禁锢，完全沦为普通人。
“请问你们要将他带去什么地方？”蓝发青年伸手拦住了准备离去的白银高阶战士，开口询问道。

“你是……”
“我是伯纳德，特莱亚行省里迪安郡驻军将军。”
听到对方的介绍，白银高阶战士将手伸进盔甲内侧取出一份文件，将其打开，上面赫然写着四个人的姓名。
蓝发青年余光一扫，整颗心瞬间沉到谷底。
特莱亚行省里迪安郡执政官费恩，治安局局长温斯顿·科马克，卫城将军马库斯以及前任驻军将军加雷斯四个人的名字全都在上面。
将文件塞回盔甲内侧后，白银高阶战士转头看向伯纳德，欠身行了一礼，开口道：“伯纳德将军，我需要您随我走一趟。”
蓝发青年回过神来，点头说道：“我跟你们走。”
被铁链束缚的费恩看了一眼伯纳德，低着头向前走。
伯纳德看着好友这番模样，张了张嘴，很想要跟这位寒冰军团带队军官求情，但最终还是将嘴闭上了。
没过多久，水晶庄园内的宾客便得知了执政官费恩与驻军将军伯纳德被带走的消息。
大部分官员听到这个消息时，脸色大变，纷纷找借口匆忙离去。
其余宾客见状，寒暄几句后，纷纷散去。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lord: Starting from the Pioneer Knight Volume 1: Default Chapter 2165 Genzheng Miaohong (..la) "Stop."
At the entrance of the manor, an officer raised his hand to stop the Ice Legion soldiers.
The high-level silver warrior raised his hand to stop the advancing troops, strode to the entrance of the manor, and showed the arrest order document.
The officer looked at the content above and his pupils narrowed.
He couldn't tell the authenticity of the seal above, but based on the content above, he felt that no one would dare to forge this order document.
"Now you can get out of the way." The senior silver soldier folded the order document and stuffed it inside the armor, looked up at the officer in front of him, and said.
"Yes."
The officer gritted his teeth, waved his hand to signal his men to step back and clear the way.
Seeing this, the high-ranking Baiyin warrior waved his subordinates to enter the manor.
At the entrance, the blue-haired young man looked at the army entering the manor and was stunned for a moment.
"Bernard, I'm telling you..."
Finn looked up at the silver-armored army coming towards them, especially the familiar marks on the armor, which made him lose his voice for an instant.
Since the lord moved into the palace of Okla City, the Star Prayer Legion and the Ice Legion have assumed the duties of the palace guards and the guards of Okla City.
The now-organized Ice Legion soldiers are certainly not here to convey orders.
After the high-level silver warrior glanced at Bernard, he turned to look at Finn standing aside and said in a deep voice: "Are you Finn?"
"I am." Finn put away the distracting thoughts in his heart and answered very calmly.
"It's good if it's you." After looking at Finn up and down, the high-level silver warrior immediately ordered, "Capture him."
Two low-level silver warriors stepped forward and tied Finn up with ropes.
The iron chain fell, and the magic circle hidden in the iron chain was activated. In just a moment, the fighting spirit in Finn's body was completely imprisoned, and he became completely reduced to an ordinary person.
"Where are you taking him?" The blue-haired young man reached out to stop the high-level silver warrior who was about to leave, and asked.
"You are..."
"I am Bernard, the garrison general of Lydian County, Traia Province."
After hearing the other party's introduction, the senior silver warrior reached into the inside of his armor and took out a document, opened it, and the names of four people were clearly written on it.
The blue-haired young man glanced out of the corner of his eye, and his whole heart sank to the bottom of his heart.
The names of four people, including Finn, the consul of Lydian County in Trea Province, Winston Cormac, the director of the Security Bureau, Marcus, the general of the Acropolis, and Gareth, the former garrison general, are all on it.
After stuffing the document back into the armor, the senior silver warrior turned to look at Bernard, bowed and said, "General Bernard, I need you to come with me."
The blue-haired young man came to his senses, nodded and said, "I'll go with you."
Finn, who was bound by chains, glanced at Bernard, lowered his head and walked forward.
Bernard looked at his friend's appearance and opened his mouth. He wanted to plead with the Ice Legion leader, but he finally closed his mouth.
It didn't take long for the guests in the Crystal Manor to learn that Archon Finn and the garrison general Bernard had been taken away.
When most of the officials heard the news, their expressions changed drastically, and they all found excuses and left in a hurry.
Upon seeing this, the other guests dispersed after exchanging a few words.
